observations.humor_timing: Short dialogue paragraphs give the two-hammock logic time to land. Sofa becoming a chair is a concise visual-listing reversal. Buddy investigating the gnome and then fearing its equipment escalates his own mistake. Empty shelf inspected twice earns Sagar moving the laptop. Bed-frame reveal pauses on Buddy looking at wood then Sagar before cushion claim. These specific events vary the list-heavy royal negotiation framing.
observations.voices_agency: Neet demands sunlight, surveillance, access and treats with theatrical certainty. Buddy independently wants exclusion, changes alliance, checks evidence, pursues the wrong bed, claims the correct cushion and chooses company. Heather secures two hammocks, examines the gnome and finds the house; Sagar uses measurement and practical limits. Affection remains beneath disagreement.
observations.cause_effect_payoff: Failed listings expose incompatible wishes; alliances and tours lead to an all-members condition, a suitable house and move. Private rooms remain meaningful because Buddy can close his door later. Neet choosing Sagar after winning his blanket completes the opening desire without explaining away the emotion.

placement_and_contribution.finding: After the room-begins-here line: hidden notepad corner under Buddy, nosy Neet, swatches and spatula create the first physical boundary gag.
After unseen-behind-shelf line and before removal: empty laptop shelves remain reachable under Neet paw; sleepy Buddy makes the contrast readable.

After both room choices: sunlit Neet and shaded Buddy by closet vent convey satisfied aftermath of claiming spaces, before move. Contrasting spaces add information rather than another reaction portrait.
After delivery-complete: both Buddy forepaws press cushion in open box while bed-frame parts remain behind; wrong object and correct object simultaneously carry the misunderstanding.

After Heather notes both dogs outside, before Buddy shuts eyes: two open-eyed resting dogs with humans feet, mugs, string lights and toy depict exact reunion state. Final blanket sentences remain beyond the image and retain closing emphasis.
